These commands are available three ways — in the FREE-WILi GUI app, in a serial
terminal, and on the device itself. See
[Connecting it to a computer](../start-here/connecting.md) for how to reach them.

## CAN1 Mode

CAN Type or UART over CAN PHY

**How to use it** — press `a`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## CAN1 Rate

Baudrate of CAN or UART over CAN PHY

**How to use it** — press `b`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## CAN1 FD D Rate

Baud Rate for CANFD Data section

**How to use it** — press `c`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## CAN1 Listen Only

Enables Listen Only mode

**How to use it** — press `y`.

## CAN1 Tx Retry

CAN Transmit retry options

**How to use it** — press `e`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## CAN1 Cust Baud

Hex Value String for Register C1NBTCFG. Blank to disable.

**How to use it** — press `f`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## CAN1 Cust Data Baud

Hex Value String for Register C1DBTCFG

**How to use it** — press `g`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## CAN1 Termination

Enables termination for network.

**How to use it** — press `1`.

## CAN1 API Enabled

Set Wili API Base ID

**How to use it** — press `i`.

## CAN API ID

Enables Terminal over CANFD

**How to use it** — press `j`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## CAN2 Mode

CAN Type or UART over CAN PHY

**How to use it** — press `k`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## CAN2 Rate

Baudrate of CAN or UART over CAN PHY

**How to use it** — press `l`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## CAN2 FD D Rate

Baud Rate for CANFD Data section

**How to use it** — press `m`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## CAN2 Listen Only

Enables Listen Only mode

**How to use it** — press `n`.

## CAN2 Tx Retry

CAN Transmit retry options

**How to use it** — press `o`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## CAN2 Cust Baud

Hex Value String for Register C1NBTCFG. Blank to disable.

**How to use it** — press `p`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## CAN2 Cust Data Baud

Hex Value String for Register C1DBTCFG

**How to use it** — press `r`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## CAN2 Termination

Enables termination for network.

**How to use it** — press `s`.

## CAN2 API Enabled

Enables Wili API over CANFD

**How to use it** — press `t`.

## LIN Master En

Enables LIN Master Pull Resistor

**How to use it** — press `u`.

## LIN Baud Rate

Baud Rate for LIN

**How to use it** — press `v`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## Analog In En

Enables analog input measurement

**How to use it** — press `x`.
